suppress.notes: Added 2026-10-23, re-check by 2027-01-23. CVE-2026-0994 affects google.protobuf.json_format.ParseDict() in the Python protobuf package (RecursionError on nested Any). protobuf-java is a different implementation and this app never parses JSON Any messages from untrusted input. CPE false positive.

Added 2026-10-23, re-check by 2027-01-23. CVE-2026-42154 is a memory-allocation DoS in the Prometheus server's remote-read endpoint (fixed in server 3.5.3 / 3.11.3). It was matched to micrometer-registry-prometheus through the cpe prometheus:prometheus. The Micrometer registry is a client library that only renders the scrape text; it contains no remote-read endpoint or snappy decoding.

Added 2026-10-22, re-check by 2027-01-22. CVE-2025-7962 is an SMTP injection in Jakarta Mail (angus-mail, fixed in 2.0.2). It was matched to angus-activation 2.0.3 through a low-confidence CPE (eclipse:angus_mail). angus-activation has no mail code and we send no email. No angus-activation release carries a fix because the artifact is not affected.
